# Patton Protocol

Scope, plan, dispatch, observe, reconcile, verify, and report describe the
lifecycle, with a delegation threshold, bounded missions, immutable
ownership, evidence rechecking, conflict handling, partial failure recovery,
human approval for irreversible actions, and a fallback that runs one
mission at a time in the main loop when a host cannot spawn workers.
